Patient: I feel a tightness in my chest, and my lips look a little blue.

Agent: My disposition is to refer you to the emergency department immediately. Do not attempt self-care; this requires emergency evaluation.
Agent: Do not drive yourself. Call 911 if symptoms worsen.
Patient: Okay, I'll head there now.
